title: The Sky Lantern Quest
description: Four adventurous friends journey to the magical Floating Hill to light the Great Sky Lantern and bring brightness back to their village.

scenes.description: Wide-angle tracking shot of a cozy Indian village under soft cloudy skies, dim lanterns swaying gently, Ravi in foreground looking up with determination.
scenes.visual_prompt: (small Indian village:1.3) with narrow paths, clay houses with thatched roofs, dim lanterns hanging from wooden poles, (boy Ravi:1.2) in foreground looking up determined, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), warm golden colors, wide shot
scenes.narration: एक छोटे से गाँव में, जहाँ लालटेन की रौशनी धीमी पड़ गई थी, रवि ने आसमान की ओर देखा और ठान लिया कि वह इसे फिर से जगमगाएगा।
scenes.subtitle: The Promise

scenes.description: Medium shot of Ravi in the village square calling to Anya, Kabir, and Meera, pointing at a map spread on a wooden crate.
scenes.visual_prompt: (four kids:1.3) gathered in open village square, treasure map spread on wooden crate, Ravi pointing at the map, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), warm sunset light, medium shot
scenes.narration: रवि ने गाँव के चौक में अन्या, कबीर और मीरा को बुलाया और उन्हें फ़्लोटिंग हिल का नक्शा दिखाया।
scenes.subtitle: Gathering the Team

scenes.description: Side shot of friends walking through tall golden wheat swaying in the breeze, bright morning sky above.
scenes.visual_prompt: (four kids:1.3) walking single file through tall golden wheat fields, wheat swaying in wind, bright blue morning sky, (storybook children's illustration:1.4), side view shot
scenes.narration: सुबह की सुनहरी धूप में, चारों दोस्त गेहूँ के खेतों से गुज़रते हुए अपनी यात्रा पर निकल पड़े।
scenes.subtitle: Through the Fields

scenes.description: Dynamic overhead shot of friends leaping across giant glowing lily pads on a magical river.
scenes.visual_prompt: (four kids:1.3) jumping from one large glowing lily pad to another, on wide magical river with sparkles, ripples of golden light in water, (storybook fantasy cartoon:1.4), overhead dynamic view
scenes.narration: वे एक चमकती नदी के किनारे पहुँचे, जहाँ बड़े-बड़े कमल के पत्ते तैर रहे थे। उन्हें पार करने के लिए कूदना पड़ा।
scenes.subtitle: The Lily Pad Crossing

scenes.description: Close-up of a talking parrot in a bright red vest, holding a golden key in its beak, perched on a branch.
scenes.visual_prompt: (cartoon parrot:1.3) wearing bright red vest, holding shiny golden key in beak, perched on thick tree branch, big expressive eyes, (storybook whimsical style:1.4), close-up
scenes.narration: एक बोलने वाला तोता, लाल जैकेट पहने, उनके पास आया और उन्हें एक सुनहरी चाबी दी।
scenes.subtitle: The Helpful Parrot

scenes.description: Wide shot of the Floating Hill suspended in clouds, glowing giant lantern at the top, kids gazing in awe.
scenes.visual_prompt: (large grassy hill:1.4) floating high above fluffy white clouds, clear visible gap from ground, giant glowing lantern on hilltop, (four kids:1.2) standing on nearby cliff looking amazed, bright magical light, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), wide shot
scenes.narration: आख़िरकार, वे बादलों में तैरते हुए पहाड़ तक पहुँचे, जिसकी चोटी पर एक विशाल लालटेन चमक रही थी।
scenes.subtitle: The Floating Hill

scenes.description: Medium shot of kids unlocking and lighting the giant lantern together, golden glow illuminating their faces.
scenes.visual_prompt: (four kids:1.3) together turning golden key and lighting giant glowing lantern, warm golden light on faces, night sky in background, (storybook whimsical style:1.4), medium shot
scenes.narration: चारों ने मिलकर लालटेन खोली और उसे जलाया, जिसकी रौशनी पूरे आसमान में फैल गई।
scenes.subtitle: Lighting the Lantern

scenes.description: Pull-back night shot of kids walking back into a brightly lit village, warm lights glowing in windows.
scenes.visual_prompt: (four kids:1.3) walking down path toward brightly lit village, warm yellow window lights, starry night sky, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), pull-back wide shot
scenes.narration: वह वापस लौटे, और उनका गाँव फिर से रौशनी से भर गया। सबने खुश होकर उनका स्वागत किया।
scenes.subtitle: Home Again
